prompt: Why are two swatches attached to the shop’s ticket copy?
promptZh: 為什麼店家的領件單存根上附了兩塊布樣？

options.text: To show the exact materials already fitted to the coat
options.zh: 標示已裝到大衣上的確切布料
options.whyZh: 袖口尚未施工，布樣不是已安裝材料。

options.text: To confirm which fabric the customer chose at the first visit
options.zh: 確認顧客第一次選的布料
options.whyZh: 原先選定的布料已缺貨，這兩塊是替代選項。

options.text: To mark the coat as paid in full
options.whyZh: 付款狀態另外記在下襬項目，布樣不是付款證明。

options.text: To give the customer alternatives for possible cuff work
options.zh: 提供日後修改袖口的替代布料
options.whyZh: 原選布料缺貨，因此附上兩塊替代布樣供顧客選擇。

explanationZh: 原選布料缺貨，因此附上兩塊替代布樣供顧客選擇。
evidence: The fabric selected at the first visit is no longer in stock. … two substitute swatches

vocabulary.note: 用於比對顏色或材質的小塊布。
